h1: A page that sells. An agent that answers.
lead: Your business loses money through two doors: people who can't find where to pay you, and people who write and get no reply. We close both, for any kind of business, at a fixed price and a fixed date.
meta_hero: We reply the same day. No strings attached.
s1_t: The two leaks every business has
s1_s: It doesn't matter whether you sell consultations, food, houses, classes or spare parts. Money escapes through the same two places.
f1_t: The customer wants to pay and can't
f1_p: They ask your price by message, you reply, you send your bank details, they think it over and cool off. Every extra step between intent and payment costs you sales.
f2_t: The customer writes and nobody answers
f2_p: They write at eleven at night, on a Sunday, or while you're serving someone else. Anyone who doesn't get an answer within minutes writes to the next business. That sale never comes back.
s2_s: Two pieces that work together: one sells when you're away, the other answers when you can't.

s6_l:
Why 50% off?

Because Forja Labs has just opened and we would rather build a portfolio of happy clients than charge top rates from day one. The discount ends on 16 March 2027, and the price stays fixed for anyone who signs before then.

Is my business too small for this?

If you already have customers writing to you, it isn't. The smaller the team, the more each unanswered message costs.

Do I need to understand technology?

No. You describe your business and approve what we show you. We do the rest and hand you a simple manual.

Where does my customers' money go?

Into your own Stripe account, connected to your bank. Forja Labs never touches your payments.

Can the agent make things up?

It is trained on your real business information and told explicitly what not to answer. When it doesn't know something, it says so and hands over the conversation. You approve the answers before it goes live.

Will the agent scare my customers away?

It introduces itself as an assistant, never pretends to be you, and hands over the conversation the moment a case is delicate. The real alternative isn't you replying instantly: it's nobody replying.

Why does the agent have a monthly fee and the page doesn't?

Because every conversation consumes AI and hosting that are paid month by month. The page, once delivered, consumes nothing: its maintenance is optional.

Do you work outside Mexico?

Yes. We work remotely and charge in Mexican pesos; your bank handles the conversion. The page and the agent can be delivered in whatever language your customers speak.

What if I don't like what I see?

You see it before we build anything. If we don't agree at the proposal stage, the second 50% is never paid and the commitment ends there.
s7_p: One message is enough. I reply the same day and tell you what suits you, even if the answer is that you don't need anything yet.
